name: Hierarchical Sampled Point Volume Visualization
definition: A volume visualization method that replaces voxels with hierarchically sampled points to enable real-time previewing of 3D scalar fields. It solves the problem of time-consuming trial-and-error tuning of viewing parameters by allowing constant frame rate rendering through level-of-detail control.
summary: Hierarchical Sampled Point Volume Visualization replaces voxels with sampled points to enable constant-time, real-time 3D field previewing, avoiding the heavy reconstruction costs of frequency domain methods.
